name: Synthetic overlap and bottleneck-shift example
assumptions: Analytic example: independent GPU streams, explicit finish-to-start checkpoint dependencies, calibrated service ratios and fixed host preparation. Not a real hardware forecast.
scaling_assumption: Ideal balanced GPU work per representative partition; fixed global problem for strong scaling and fixed per-node work for weak scaling. No graph duplication.

phases.name: Compute-bound kernel A
phases.assumption: Same kernel work and geometry; effective compute throughput is the limiting service rate.

phases.name: Roofline kernel B
phases.assumption: Declared work and physical byte counts; maximum of compute and memory service costs.

phases.name: Checkpoint
phases.assumption: Fixed global checkpoint bytes; effective service bandwidth models the API-visible operation, without changing durability semantics.
